Q3 · MD 🔥

A bond costs $90 today and pays $100 in one year. What's the yield?

A9.0%
B10.0%
C10.5%
D11.1%

Most people say 10%.

Answer 3
D. 11.1%

You earn $10 on the $90 you paid, not on $100. $10 ÷ $90 = 11.1%.
